title: Why Kyren Williams and Blake Corum might be the key to saving the Rams' season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Why Kyren Williams and Blake Corum might be the key to saving the Rams' season
sources.description: Sunday was exactly what Sean McVay envisioned from his two-back system. And with multiple injuries on offense, it might be up to the running game to save the Rams' season.
